name: Check Init Wrapper
description: Verifies at runtime that the init wrapper /usr/local/sbin/proxvex-init took effect: the container's init starts it, net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start and every container_sysctls key hold the requested values, and eth0 carries ipv6_token. Writing the wrapper succeeds even when it is never executed, so only reading the live values back proves it. No-op (passes) when unprivileged_port_start, container_sysctls and ipv6_token are all empty; skip_if_all_missing cannot be used because 107/109 declare these parameters.
